run_web_search: run the web_search_tool with a query string to search the web and return JSON results with title, url, and snippet
run_web_fetch: run the web_fetch_tool with a URL to scrape the page and return markdown content truncated to 4096 characters
build_firecrawl_client: build a FirecrawlApp client from app config with an optional api_key for web_search or web_fetch tool usage
test_web_search_tool: test the web_search_tool by passing a query and verifying it returns a JSON array of search result objects
test_web_fetch_tool: test the web_fetch_tool by passing a valid URL and verifying it returns the page title and markdown content
